marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34520GB Cordless 5-Spot Green Line Laser offers a cordless design for convenience and features a self-leveling system with a magnetic mount for easy setup. This laser has a working range of 330 ft with a detector and 280 ft without, and provides an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft. It includes a 5-spot green line laser, ceiling/wall bracket, and laser target, and is compatible with the 20V MAX* cordless platform.
